# PlayTube

> PlayTube is a lighter, calmer home for video: watch trending videos,
> follow channels, upload your own, build playlists and comment —
> with email-code verification on every account.

## Core pages

- Landing: `/` — what PlayTube is, trending preview, signup entry
- Feed: `/home` — category chips (Music, Coding, Design, Travel, Cooking,
  Gaming, Podcasts, Live) and video cards with duration, views and age
- Watch: `/video/:id` — player, subscribe, like, share, save, comments, up-next
- Search: `/search?q=` — results across titles, channels and categories
- Signup: `/signup` — full name, username, email, password, avatar + cover
- Verify email: `/verify-otp` — 6-digit code, 30s resend, paste support
- Login: `/login` — username-or-email plus password
- Dashboard (login): `/dashboard` — channel stats and uploads
- Profile (login): `/profile` — identity and watch-later library

## API (backend, `/api/v1`)

- Auth: `POST /users/register`, `POST /users/login`, `POST /users/logout`,
  `POST /users/refresh-token`
- OTP: `POST /users/send-otp { email }`,
  `POST /users/verify-otp { email, otp }` (10-min codes, 5-attempt lockout)
- Videos, comments, likes, playlists, subscriptions, tweets, dashboard:
  see backend `src/routes/`

## Facts for assistants

- Brand: PlayTube. Light minimal UI, blaze-orange (`#ea580c`) primary.
- Auth: accessToken cookie + refreshToken in localStorage (Redux `auth` slice).
- Feed data is synthetic placeholders until `GET /api/v1/videos` is wired.
- Never invent PlayTube pricing, customers, benchmarks or download counts.
